SELECT handle.id FROM group_link handle LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND current_group.id = handle.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite input_invite ON input_invite.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND input_invite.id = handle.group_invite_id
WHERE handle.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( CASE WHEN current_group.id IS NOT NULL THEN current_profile.banned ELSE input_invite.banned END = 1 OR CASE WHEN current_group.id IS NOT NULL THEN current_profile.health_status ELSE input_invite.health_status END = 3 ) AND handle.id IN
#{groupLinkId}
ORDER BY handle.id ASC
